cat-whole-file.title: Read a Small File with `cat`
cat-whole-file.bodyMarkdown: `cat` prints the complete contents of a text file without changing it. It works best for short files.

head-tail-preview.title: Preview the Beginning and End
head-tail-preview.bodyMarkdown: `head` shows the beginning of a file and `tail` shows the end. They are useful when printing an entire long file would be noisy.

wc-line-count.title: Count Lines with `wc -l`
wc-line-count.bodyMarkdown: `wc -l file` reports how many lines the file contains. Use it when the number of line-based records matters.
